title: atomic_json dir-safety check fails under umask 002 (group-writable checkout)
description: Found during q6ko.1 verification: python/tests/ipv6/test_key_address_cross_impl_vectors.py::test_committed_ipv6_address_vectors_match_stdlib_generator fails on hosts where the checkout is group-writable (umask 002): test/vectors/atomic_json.py _open_owned_directory rejects st_mode & 0o022, so generate_ipv6_addresses.py --check dies with 'atomic JSON parent directory is unsafe'. Reproduces on a pristine HEAD worktree on this Linux host (drwxrwxr-x test/vectors). Unrelated to the q6ko quarantine change. Decide: relax to 0o002-only (owner+group same uid intent), chmod in test setup, or document umask requirement. Labels: python, testing.
